subject: Staged no-PO authorization request — TinkerCloud pilot
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@tinkercloud.io>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood pilot — PO flexibility for early-stage partner

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineering team at TinkerCloud is excited to move forward with the 90-day pilot. Procurement asked whether Redwood requires a purchase order for pilot invoices. Our standard is typically invoice-only for early pilots under $7k/month, but we need to confirm Redwood's rules to set up our accounting.

I've attached our W-9 and a short SOC2 summary for your records. Can we get a temporary vendor setup that allows us to invoice without a PO for the pilot period? If needed, we can sign a short MSA addendum or a payment terms sheet.

Next steps from our side: we plan to kick off Nov 16 and invoice monthly. Let me know what intake form or evidence you need.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Partnerships | TinkerCloud
Attachments: tinkercloud-w9.pdf, tinkercloud-soc2-summary.pdf

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira@tinkercloud.io>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-09T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — PO flexibility for early-stage partner

Samira — thanks for sending the docs and for the clear plan. Happy to move this forward.

Short answer: we can do a temporary no-PO path for pilots under a staged agreement, but procurement will require a short checklist and finance sign-off. Proposed guardrails (suggested by Ops):
- Pilot capped at $6,000/month for up to 3 months
- TinkerCloud completes vendor intake questionnaire (linked)
- Evidence: W-9 + SOC2 summary (received)
- Invoices to reference Redwood deal ID (DEAL-48321) and be sent to accounts-payable@redwood.com
- Redwood to create temporary vendor ID with 90-day authorization window

I'll loop in procurement and procurement ops internally to request the temporary exception. If you can confirm the monthly cap and start date (Nov 16), I'll push this through today.

Cc'ing Priyom (finance intake) to confirm accounting steps.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-10T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary no-PO authorization for TinkerCloud pilot (DEAL-48321)

Team — quick intake for your review. TinkerCloud (external) is requesting an invoice-only path for a 90-day pilot starting Nov 16. I verified they provided W-9 and SOC2 summary (attached). Proposed parameters: cap $6k/month, 3 months, vendor temporary ID, invoices to AP. I also attached a draft "staged no-PO checklist" (redwood-staged-no-po-checklist.xlsx) that outlines required items for approval.

Why I think we should approve: pilot valuable for us (edge inference workloads) and low dollar exposure; allows faster time-to-value and lowers friction for engineering trial. Risks: invoice processing outside PO controls; mitigations in checklist (invoice naming convention, limited authorization window, contract addendum).

Requesting:
- Priyom: finance sign-off on temporary vendor flows and any GL/account coding requirements.
- Laura: procurement ops to create the temporary vendor record and confirm whether we need a P-card holdback or other controls.

If you can approve with any redlines before EOD, I'll confirm to the customer and request their PO-exemption acknowledgement form.

Thanks,
Soojin

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-13T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO authorization for TinkerCloud pilot (DEAL-48321)

Soojin / Laura — reviewed. Finance is comfortable approving a staged no-PO authorization under the following conditions:
- Cap enforced at $6,000/month and finance will flag any invoice > $6,000
- Authorization window: 2026-11-16 through 2027-02-14 (90 days)
- Vendor intake must be completed and attachments ingested into Vendor Master (W-9 + SOC2 summary)
- TinkerCloud must sign an acknowledgement email accepting the temporary invoice-only terms and referencing DEAL-48321
- AP routing: invoices to accounts-payable@redwood.com with "TinkerCloud — DEAL-48321" in the subject line

Laura — please create the temporary vendor record (TEMP-TC-48321) and add a 90-day expiry. Once created, Soojin please get the customer's acknowledgement and forward to AP so we can process the first invoice.

Approving now. Priyom
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
